title: Optimal design of triply-periodic minimal surface implants for bone repair
relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对骨植入物设计，使用代理模型加速有限元模拟，并考虑约束优化，与用户的研究方向高度相关。
why_not_core: The paper does not include uncertainty quantification (UQ) and focuses on a specific TPMS implant design rather than a general surrogate method for biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高骨植入物设计效率，最大化骨长入。
summary_zh.method: 采用梯度优化和代理模型，基于有限元力学模型预测骨生长。
summary_zh.result: 在髋关节植入物上验证了方法，满足制造约束。
summary_zh.validation: 通过髋关节案例的有限元模拟验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently design bone implants that maximize bone ingrowth using a gradient-based optimization framework.
summary_en.method: A surrogate model of TPMS properties is combined with a homogenized finite element mechanobiological model to compute design sensitivities.
summary_en.result: The method successfully optimizes a cementless hip implant for bone growth under manufacturability constraints.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through a simulation case study of a cementless hip implant.

title: Thermal-Mechanical Physics Informed Deep Learning For Fast Prediction of Thermal Stress Evolution in Laser Metal Deposition
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的PINN框架可快速预测热应力演化，其方法可迁移至植入物生物力学中的代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or multi-objective constrained optimization; it focuses on thermal stress in additive manufacturing.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低金属增材制造中热应力预测的高计算成本
summary_zh.method: 提出物理信息神经网络(PINN)框架，融合控制方程与少量仿真数据
summary_zh.result: PINN模型能快速准确预测温度与热应力，且具有参数迁移能力
summary_zh.validation: 通过仿真案例验证，与数值模型对比精度与效率

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the high computational cost of predicting thermal stress evolution in metal additive manufacturing.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework is proposed, incorporating governing physical laws and small simulation data.
summary_en.result: The PINN model achieves fast and accurate prediction of temperature and thermal stress, with transferability to new process parameters.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through simulation cases, comparing accuracy and efficiency against physics-based numerical models.

title: Point-DeepONet: Predicting Nonlinear Fields on Non-Parametric Geometries under Variable Load Conditions
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的Point-DeepONet方法可直接迁移到生物力学植入物设计中的代理建模，解决非参数几何和变载荷下的快速仿真问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not validate on biomedical implant geometries or biomechanical contexts, and lacks uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统有限元仿真耗时，难以用于设计优化和实时控制。
summary_zh.method: 将PointNet集成到DeepONet框架中，从点云学习几何表示并与载荷条件融合预测位移和应力场。
summary_zh.result: R²达0.987（位移）和0.923（应力），比FEA快约400倍。
summary_zh.validation: 在随机载荷方向上进行泛化测试和消融实验。

summary_en.motivation: Nonlinear finite element simulations are computationally expensive, limiting their use in design optimization and real-time control.
summary_en.method: Point-DeepONet integrates PointNet into the DeepONet framework to learn geometric representations from raw point clouds and fuse them with load conditions for predicting displacement and von Mises stress fields.
summary_en.result: The model achieves R² of 0.987 for displacement and 0.923 for von Mises stress, and is approximately 400 times faster than nonlinear FEA.
summary_en.validation: Generalization is validated on unseen randomly oriented load directions, along with extensive experiments and ablation studies.

title: MCMC-Net: Accelerating Markov Chain Monte Carlo with Neural Networks for Inverse Problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用神经网络替代MCMC中的似然函数，加速逆问题求解，其方法可迁移至生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on PDE-based inverse problems (EIT, DOT, PAT) rather than implant/biomechanics design, and does not address constraints or uncertainty quantification in the context of surrogate modeling for FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速MCMC在逆问题中的计算，解决似然函数计算昂贵的问题。
summary_zh.method: 用神经算子替代MCMC中的真实似然函数，实现快速采样。
summary_zh.result: 在三个PDE逆问题上获得与经典方法相近的精度，并显著加速。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准（EIT、DOT、PAT）上验证精度与加速比。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate Markov Chain Monte Carlo sampling in inverse problems where likelihood evaluations are computationally expensive.
summary_en.method: Replace the true likelihood function in MCMC with a neural operator-based surrogate model.
summary_en.result: The proposed MCMC-Net achieves comparable accuracy to classical MCMC while providing significant speedup on three PDE-based inverse problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on electrical impedance tomography, diffuse optical tomography, and quantitative photoacoustic tomography.

title: Convolutional Deep Operator Networks for Learning Nonlinear Focused Ultrasound Wave Propagation in Heterogeneous Spinal Cord Anatomy
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用卷积DeepONet作为替代模型加速超声波动仿真，其方法可直接迁移到生物力学有限元代理建模中，解决昂贵采样效率问题。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on ultrasound wave propagation rather than solid mechanics or implant design, and does not address constraints or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速聚焦超声在脊髓损伤治疗中的实时压力场预测
summary_zh.method: 使用卷积DeepONet学习参数化波动方程的算子映射
summary_zh.result: 替代模型实现实时预测，测试集误差仅2%
summary_zh.validation: 基于模拟压力场数据训练并测试

summary_en.motivation: To enable real-time prediction of focused ultrasound pressure fields for surgical decision-making in spinal cord injury treatment.
summary_en.method: A convolutional DeepONet is trained to approximate the solution operator of parametric wave propagation PDEs with varying transducer positions and spinal cord geometries.
summary_en.result: The surrogate model achieves real-time predictions with only 2% test loss, significantly accelerating parameter sweeps.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on simulated pressure maps from diverse patient anatomies.

title: Inverse design of anisotropic microstructures using physics-augmented neural networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理增强神经网络用于各向异性微结构逆设计，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理建模与约束优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant-specific biomechanics, stress shielding, or patient-specific geometry; it focuses on composite microstructures and hyperelastic materials without biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决各向异性微结构逆设计中的类型与方向识别及参数优化问题。
summary_zh.method: 使用部分输入凸神经网络构建应变能代理模型，结合进化策略求解逆问题。
summary_zh.result: 模型能正确识别各向异性类型与方向，并恢复逆设计参数。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成宏观数据与均匀化数据验证，并集成到有限元框架中测试。

summary_en.motivation: To address the two-fold inverse design problem of anisotropic microstructures: identifying anisotropy type and orientation, and finding optimal design parameters for desired mechanical response.
summary_en.method: A forward surrogate model using partially Input Convex Neural Networks (pICNNs) is trained on macroscopic stress-strain data from computational homogenization, incorporating polyconvexity and physics constraints, then an evolution strategy solves the inverse problem.
summary_en.result: The invariant-based model successfully identifies anisotropy type and preferred directions, and recovers correct design parameters for inverse problems even with different preferred directions than training data.
summary_en.validation: Validation on synthetic macroscale and homogenized data, plus integration into a finite element framework to invert design parameters for desired macroscopic response.

title: Finite-PINN: A Physics-Informed Neural Network with Finite Geometric Encoding for Solid Mechanics
relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对固体力学中的PINN方法，提出了有限几何编码以处理有限边界和复杂几何，与用户关注的FEA替代模型高度相关。
why_not_core: The paper does not include uncertainty quantification, multi-objective optimization, or implant/biomechanics-specific validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN在固体力学中无限域和欧几里得空间无法处理有限边界和复杂几何的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出Finite-PINN，在输入中引入有限几何编码，将解空间转换为混合欧几里得-拓扑空间。
summary_zh.result: 在正向和逆向固体力学问题上均能高效逼近解，且能从稀疏观测重构全场解。
summary_zh.validation: 通过固体力学算例（如梁、板等）进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address the limitations of standard PINN in solid mechanics, namely infinite domain assumption and Euclidean solution space that cannot handle finite boundaries and complex geometries.
summary_en.method: A Finite-PINN architecture is proposed that incorporates finite geometric encoding into network inputs, transforming the solution space into a hybrid Euclidean-topological space.
summary_en.result: The model efficiently approximates solutions for forward solid mechanics problems and reconstructs full-field solutions from sparse observations for inverse problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical simulation cases on typical solid mechanics structures (e.g., beams, plates) are used for validation.

title: A physics-informed transformer neural operator for learning generalized solutions of initial boundary value problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理信息Transformer神经算子（PINTO）能够高效学习偏微分方程的解，且无需仿真数据，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant or biomechanics FEA, nor does it handle constraints or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子需大量仿真数据且无法泛化到新边界条件。
summary_zh.method: 提出PINTO，利用交叉注意力机制实现迭代核积分算子，仅用物理损失训练。
summary_zh.result: 在多个PDE测试中，误差仅为其他方法的五分之一到三分之一。
summary_zh.validation: 在平流、Burgers和Navier-Stokes方程上进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operators require large simulation datasets and fail to generalize to unseen initial and boundary conditions.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed transformer neural operator (PINTO) is developed using cross-attention-based iterative kernel integral operators, trained solely with physics loss.
summary_en.result: PINTO achieves relative errors one-fifth to one-third of competing methods on advection, Burgers, and Navier-Stokes equations under unseen conditions.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on five PDE test cases including steady and unsteady flows.

visual.caption: Figure 1: Schematic of PINTO: Our neural operator has three stages (i) Query Point, Initial/Boundary Point and Initial/Boundary Value (lifting operators) (ii) Cross Attention Units (iterative kernel intergral operators) and (iii) output projection dense layers.

title: FE-PINNs: finite-element-based physics-informed neural networks for surrogate modeling
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种利用有限元法训练物理信息神经网络的新方法，直接解决了代理建模中的采样效率问题，且方法可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计。
why_not_core: The paper does not address uncertainty quantification, constraint handling, or multi-objective optimization, and it only demonstrates linear boundary-value problems without extension to nonlinear or biomechanical contexts.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用有限元法高效训练物理信息神经网络，用于代理建模。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于逆等参映射的模板卷积操作，将有限元法融入PINN训练。
summary_zh.result: 在多种线性边值问题上取得合理精度，且测试误差随训练几何数量增加而降低。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证，比较不同几何条件下的预测精度。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a surrogate modeling framework that leverages finite element methods to efficiently train physics-informed neural networks.
summary_en.method: A custom convolutional operation called stencil convolution, based on the inverse isoparametric map of FEM, is used to integrate FEM into PINN training.
summary_en.result: The trained neural networks achieve reasonable accuracy on unseen geometries, with testing errors systematically decreasing as the number of training geometries increases.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks of linear boundary-value problems with varying geometries, comparing predictions to FEM solutions.

title: DeepFEA: Deep Learning for Prediction of Transient Finite Element Analysis Solutions
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的DeepFEA框架直接针对瞬态FEA的加速预测，且已在生物医学场景验证，与用户的研究方向高度相关。
why_not_core: The paper does not address constraint handling or uncertainty quantification, and the biomedical validation is limited to a single scenario without implant-specific mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速瞬态有限元分析，解决节点和单元同时预测的难题
summary_zh.method: 提出DeepFEA框架，结合ConvLSTM和双分支CNN，并设计NELO损失优化算法
summary_zh.result: 在2D和3D结构力学数据集上误差低于3%，推理速度比FEA快两个数量级
summary_zh.validation: 在结构力学基准数据集和生物医学场景中验证

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate transient finite element analysis by developing a surrogate model that simultaneously predicts nodal and elemental solutions for both 2D and 3D domains.
summary_en.method: Proposes DeepFEA, a deep learning framework using a multilayer ConvLSTM network with two parallel CNN branches, optimized by a novel Node-Element Loss Optimization (NELO) algorithm.
summary_en.result: Achieves less than 3% normalized mean and root mean squared error on 2D and 3D structural mechanics datasets, with inference speeds two orders of magnitude faster than FEA.
summary_en.validation: Validated on three publicly available structural mechanics datasets and a real-life biomedical scenario.

title: Adaptive Basis-inspired Deep Neural Network for Solving Partial Differential Equations with Localized Features
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的自适应基函数深度神经网络方法可有效处理局部特征，有望迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型中处理应力集中等局部现象。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on solving PDEs with localized features in general, but does not address implant biomechanics, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决具有局部特征（如尖锐梯度、奇异性）的偏微分方程求解难题
summary_zh.method: 受自适应有限元启发，提出自适应基函数深度神经网络，通过迭代求解-估计-标记-增强自动识别困难区域并增加神经元
summary_zh.result: 相比PINN，在相似参数量下显著降低相对误差；自适应架构可在指定容差下达到可比精度
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个具有奇异性目标函数的数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently solve partial differential equations exhibiting localized features such as sharp gradients and singularities.
summary_en.method: Inspired by adaptive finite element methods, an Adaptive Basis-inspired Deep Neural Network (ABI-DNN) is proposed, which iteratively solves, estimates, marks, and enhances by adding neurons in challenging regions, guided by a novel Basis-inspired Block (BI-block) and Kolmogorov Superposition Theorem.
summary_en.result: Both BI-DNN and ABI-DNN effectively capture singularities, achieving significantly lower relative errors than PINN with similar parameter counts, and ABI-DNN adaptively learns an architecture meeting a specified tolerance.
summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical experiments on target functions with singularities and sharp gradients.

relevance_to_user: 该论文将AI控制的数字喷嘴阵列用于高通量球体生物打印，直接相关于AI在生物打印流程中的应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI into a specific bioprinting workflow stage beyond digital control, lacks autonomous decision-making, and does not advance from observation to autonomous optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现高细胞密度的组织构建，克服现有球体生物打印的可扩展性限制。
summary_zh.method: 开发HITS-Bio系统，利用数字控制喷嘴阵列实现多球体同步高速打印。
summary_zh.result: 打印速度提升10倍，细胞活力>90%，在大鼠颅骨缺损模型中实现~96%骨覆盖。
summary_zh.validation: 通过大鼠体内骨再生实验和软骨构建体体外验证。

summary_en.motivation: To achieve physiologically-relevant cell densities in tissue fabrication by overcoming scalability limitations of spheroid bioprinting.
summary_en.method: Developed HITS-Bio, a multiarray bioprinting system using a digitally-controlled nozzle array for simultaneous high-speed positioning of multiple spheroids.
summary_en.result: Achieved tenfold faster printing speed with >90% cell viability, and demonstrated near-complete calvarial bone defect closure (~96% coverage) in a rat model.
summary_en.validation: Validated through in vivo rat calvarial bone regeneration and in vitro fabrication of scalable cartilage constructs.

title: Integration of Active Learning and MCMC Sampling for Efficient Bayesian Calibration of Mechanical Properties
relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对代理模型和MCMC采样效率问题，提出了主动学习策略，可迁移至生物力学中的材料参数校准。
why_not_core: The paper lacks experimental validation and does not address constraint handling or multi-objective optimization, which are key for implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 针对机械性能贝叶斯校准中代理模型和MCMC采样的效率与精度问题。
summary_zh.method: 基于MCMC路径的主动学习策略训练代理模型，系统比较不同方法。
summary_zh.result: 先验训练误差大，主动学习优于所有预训练模型，MCMC算法影响小。
summary_zh.validation: 基于计算力学中空间变化材料参数案例的数值对比。

summary_en.motivation: To systematically assess the combined influence of surrogate model selection and MCMC algorithms on the accuracy and efficiency of Bayesian calibration in computational mechanics.
summary_en.method: Introduce an active learning strategy based on the MCMC path to train the surrogate model, and conduct a comparative study of various surrogate modeling and sampling techniques.
summary_en.result: The active learning approach outperforms all a priori trained models, and the choice of MCMC algorithm has minimal impact on accuracy.
summary_en.validation: A scalable numerical case study involving inference of spatially varying material parameters in computational mechanics.

title: Development of customized tibial implant with advanced architected materials utilizing selective laser melting

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对胫骨植入体，采用选择性激光熔化制造先进结构材料，与用户关于AM生物医学材料的研究方向高度契合。
why_not_core: The paper does not explicitly report fatigue testing or surface roughness/as-built morphology characterization for osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发定制化胫骨植入体以减少应力遮挡和改善骨整合
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化制造多孔点阵结构实现刚度匹配
summary_zh.result: 实现了患者特异性的力学性能优化和静态机械强度验证
summary_zh.validation: 通过单轴压缩试验和结构参数表征验证力学性能

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to develop a customized tibial implant with reduced stress shielding and improved osseointegration through advanced architected materials.
summary_en.method: Lattice structures with tailored porosity were designed and fabricated using selective laser melting to achieve stiffness matching with native bone.
summary_en.result: The patient-specific implants demonstrated favorable static mechanical properties and structural integrity under compressive loading.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing, including compression tests and morphological characterization, was performed to validate the implant performance.

title: Geometric and Mechanical Properties of Ti6Al4V Skeletal Gyroid Structures Produced by Laser Powder Bed Fusion for Biomedical Implants

relevance_to_user: 该论文通过LPBF制造Ti6Al4V骨架螺旋结构，建立了几何与力学性能的关联，有助于设计低刚度植入物以缓解应力遮挡，但未涉及疲劳和骨整合评估。
why_not_core: This paper does not include fatigue testing, surface roughness characterization, or osseointegration evaluation; it focuses only on static compression and geometric properties.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究Ti6Al4V骨架螺旋结构几何与力学性能以缓解应力遮挡
summary_zh.method: 结合实验压缩和有限元模拟分析不同相对密度样品
summary_zh.result: 归一化模量和屈服应力与相对密度呈幂律关系，剪切破坏主导变形
summary_zh.validation: LPBF样品压缩实验与模拟验证

summary_en.motivation: To establish analytical correlations for pore size and strut diameter of skeletal gyroid structures and investigate their mechanical properties to mitigate stress shielding in biomedical implants.
summary_en.method: Combined experimental uniaxial compression tests and finite element simulations on LPBF-manufactured Ti6Al4V skeletal gyroid structures with varying relative densities.
summary_en.result: Normalized Young's modulus and yield stress correlate power-law with relative density, and shear-induced 45° fractures confirm bending-dominated failure with good deformability.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression tests on LPBF specimens and validated finite element simulations.

title: A probabilistic reduced-order modeling framework for patient-specific cardio-mechanical analysis
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的概率降阶建模框架结合贝叶斯推断与高斯过程，显著降低心脏力学仿真的计算成本并提供不确定性量化，其方法可直接迁移至植入物有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on cardiac mechanics rather than implant or orthopedic biomechanics, and does not address contact mechanics or manufacturing constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低心脏力学模型的计算成本以支持临床决策
summary_zh.method: 构建概率降阶模型，利用贝叶斯校准修正因子并结合高斯过程预测新几何的修正因子
summary_zh.result: 在理想和基于扫描的左心室几何上均能提供准确的在线预测及不确定性区间
summary_zh.validation: 通过理想几何和患者扫描几何两个算例验证框架有效性

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the substantial computational cost of cardiac models, enabling their clinical application while maintaining predictive accuracy.
summary_en.method: A probabilistic reduced-order modeling framework integrates a generalized one-fiber model with Bayesian-calibrated correction factors and a Gaussian process to predict factors for unseen geometries.
summary_en.result: The framework produces accurate online predictions with credible uncertainty bands for both idealized and scan-based left ventricle geometries.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on two test cases: idealized left-ventricle geometries and patient-specific scan-based geometries.

summary_en.result: The proposed scheme demonstrates accurate estimation and probabilistic assessment of quantities of interest in simulated case studies with geometric and material nonlinearities.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on multiple simulated case studies incorporating geometric and material nonlinearity with parametric dependencies.

title: Bayesian Entropy Neural Networks for Physics-Aware Prediction
relevance_to_user: 本文提出了一种能够施加约束并量化不确定性的贝叶斯熵神经网络框架，可迁移至生物力学代理模型的自适应设计优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not validate on implant or biomechanics FEA problems, nor does it integrate with an actual finite element solver for surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 深度学习模型需要集成约束以提升可靠性和数据效率。
summary_zh.method: 基于最大熵原理和拉格朗日乘子法构建贝叶斯熵神经网络。
summary_zh.result: 在梁变形和微结构生成任务中约束满足和不确定性量化均优于传统BNN。
summary_zh.validation: 通过梁变形模拟和微结构生成数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Deep learning models need to incorporate well-defined constraints for robust surrogate modeling and uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: The Bayesian Entropy Neural Network (BENN) framework uses Maximum Entropy principles and the method of multipliers to impose constraints on predictions, derivatives, and variances.
summary_en.result: BENN achieves improved constraint satisfaction and uncertainty quantification, outperforming standard Bayesian neural networks on beam deflection and microstructure generation benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via numerical benchmarks on beam deflection and microstructure generation tasks.

title: Bayesian neural networks for predicting uncertainty in full-field material response
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯U-Net代理模型可直接用于生物力学植入物设计中的应力场预测及不确定性量化，提高昂贵仿真采样的效率。
why_not_core: This paper does not address optimization constraints, multi-objective design, or biomechanics-specific implant applications; it focuses purely on surrogate modeling for material stress fields.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决微观结构应力场预测的计算成本高昂问题
summary_zh.method: 采用贝叶斯U-Net架构进行图像到图像的应力场预测与不确定性量化
summary_zh.result: 预测精度高，不确定性估计依赖于推理方法
summary_zh.validation: 与有限元分析结果对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To address the high computational cost of stress field predictions in microstructured materials.
summary_en.method: Modified Bayesian U-net architecture with three inference algorithms for image-to-image mapping from microstructure to stress field with epistemic uncertainty.
summary_en.result: High predictive accuracy compared to FEA, with inference-dependent uncertainty estimates.
summary_en.validation: Systematic comparison against FEA solutions for fiber-reinforced composite and polycrystalline microstructures.

visual.caption: Figure 1 : Schematic representation of the surrogate modeling and uncertainty quantification scheme. The U-net architecture incorporates dropout layers for the MCD technique or probabilistic filter parameters for the BBB and HMC methods. For predictions, the dropout layers or the Bayesian parameters are sampled to generate multiple stress predictions. The mean prediction is obtained averaging the resulting fields and model uncertainty is estimated by computing the standard deviation of the ensemble predictions.

title: Quantifying Local Model Validity using Active Learning
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过主动学习高效估计局部模型误差，直接适用于代理模型的不确定性量化与采样优化，可迁移至植入物/生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling or biomechanics design, and does not address constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少评估机器学习模型局部有效性所需的数据量。
summary_zh.method: 通过主动学习策略学习模型误差，以高效获取局部有效性估计。
summary_zh.result: 仅用少量数据即可获得足够区分性的误差模型，且对局部变化敏感。
summary_zh.validation: 在模型验证基准数据集上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Local model validity estimation typically requires substantial data; we propose an active learning approach to reduce the data demand.
summary_en.method: We learn the model error via active learning to estimate local validity with minimal data acquisition.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves high discriminative power for error detection with small datasets and exhibits superior sensitivity to local validity changes compared to baselines.
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation is conducted on standard model validation benchmarks.

title: VS-PINN: A fast and efficient training of physics-informed neural networks using variable-scaling methods for solving PDEs with stiff behavior
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种加速PINN训练的新方法，直接适用于FEA替代建模中的高效求解，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。

summary_zh.method: 提出基于变量缩放的方法以加速PINN训练，并借助神经正切核分析提供理论支持
summary_zh.result: 数值实验表明该方法显著提高了训练效率和性能

summary_en.motivation: To address the training difficulties of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) when solving PDEs with stiff or high-frequency behavior.
summary_en.method: A variable-scaling method is proposed to accelerate PINN training, with theoretical justification provided through neural tangent kernel (NTK) analysis.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments on various stiff PDEs demonstrate significant improvements in training efficiency and prediction accuracy.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on multiple benchmark PDEs exhibiting stiff behavior and rapidly varying solutions.

title: VENI, VINDy, VICI: a generative reduced-order modeling framework with uncertainty quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的生成式降阶模型框架结合了不确定性量化，可迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真替代建模。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it handle constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_en.motivation: To address the high computational cost and lack of interpretability and reliability in simulating complex PDE systems.
summary_en.method: A generative reduced-order modeling framework combining variational autoencoders for dimensionality reduction and a novel variational SINDy for interpretable dynamics identification with uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: The framework demonstrates accurate and interpretable predictions with uncertainty intervals on PDE benchmarks including structural mechanics and fluid dynamics.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks: the Rössler system, structural mechanics, and fluid dynamics cases.

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the slow training and limited accuracy of physics-informed neural networks caused by gradient descent and non-causal time treatment.
summary_en.method: Frozen-PINN employs space-time separation and random features to avoid gradient descent, while incorporating temporal causality by construction.
summary_en.result: Frozen-PINN achieves orders-of-magnitude improvements in training efficiency and accuracy over state-of-the-art PINNs on eight PDE benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on eight challenging PDE benchmarks including advection, shocks, and high-dimensional problems.

summary_zh.validation: 使用合成噪声数据和实验数据，与有限元校准结果对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enable rapid calibration of constitutive models from full-field data for real-time structural health monitoring.
summary_en.method: A parametric physics-informed neural network is trained offline to learn parameterized PDE solutions, then used online as a surrogate for deterministic least-squares or Bayesian calibration.
summary_en.result: Deterministic calibration achieves high accuracy, Bayesian uncertainty estimates are valid, and calibration is near real-time.
summary_en.validation: Validated on noisy synthetic data and experimental data, with results in good agreement with finite element-based calibration.

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the prohibitive cost of generating large geometry-solution datasets for neural operators in engineering design optimization.
summary_en.method: Proposes Reference Neural Operators (RNO) that learn the smooth mapping from geometric deformations to PDE solutions using a reference solution.
summary_en.result: RNO achieves up to 80% error reduction compared to baselines with significantly fewer training samples.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks with various types and numbers of geometric objects.

title: Enhancing Multiscale Simulations with Constitutive Relations-Aware Deep Operator Networks

summary_zh.motivation: 多尺度有限元计算成本高，需要高效代理模型。

summary_zh.validation: 通过准静态固体力学算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Multiscale finite element simulations are computationally expensive, motivating the development of efficient surrogate models.
summary_en.method: A constitutive relations-aware DeepONet is proposed, embedding microscale constitutive laws into the network architecture to predict strains and stresses from macroscale inputs.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves accurate predictions even with limited training data.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on quasi-static solid mechanics problems using numerical simulation cases.

title: CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for Operator Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的连续视觉Transformer算子学习方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，提高采样效率并处理多尺度特征。

summary_en.motivation: Existing operator learning methods struggle with complex physical systems, motivating a more flexible architecture.
summary_en.method: CViT combines a vision transformer encoder, grid-based coordinate embedding, and query-wise cross-attention for continuous operator learning.
summary_en.result: Achieves state-of-the-art on multiple PDE benchmarks, outperforming larger foundation models without extensive pretraining.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks including fluid dynamics, climate modeling, and reaction-diffusion PDEs.

title: Conformalized Physics-Informed Neural Networks

summary_zh.result: 70%-90%孔隙率支架的力学性能匹配天然骨，WPA支架模量更高，WPD支架血流动力学更优。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩实验和仿真验证力学和血流动力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the biomechanical viability of Weaire-Phelan titanium alloy scaffolds as bone replacement components.
summary_en.method: Weaire-Phelan scaffolds of varying porosity were additively manufactured and assessed via finite element analysis, computational fluid dynamics, and uniaxial compression tests.
summary_en.result: Scaffolds with 70% to 90% porosity exhibited mechanical properties comparable to trabecular bone; WPA scaffolds showed higher compressive modulus while WPD scaffolds demonstrated better hemodynamic performance.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (uniaxial compression) and numerical simulations (FEA, CFD) validated the structural and hemodynamic properties.

title: Small design modifications can improve the primary stability of a fully coated tapered wedge hip stem.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institute of Biomechanics, TUHH Hamburg University of Technology, Hamburg, Germany.

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究全涂层锥形楔形股骨柄的设计改进对初始稳定性的影响，通过尸体实验测量微动和下沉，与髋关节植入物研究方向高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding or bone remodeling, nor does it use computational modeling (FEA) or patient-specific simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过设计改进提高全涂层锥形楔形股骨柄在Dorr A型股骨中的初始稳定性。
summary_zh.method: 使用尸体股骨对（n=6）植入两种柄，记录植入力、接触面积，并在ISO循环加载下用DIC测量微动。
summary_zh.result: 改进柄植入力高40%，接触面积大23%，下沉量低4倍，初始稳定性显著提高。
summary_zh.validation: 尸体实验结合ISO 7206-4循环加载和数字图像相关测量。

summary_en.motivation: To assess whether small design modifications to a fully coated tapered wedge hip stem improve primary stability in Dorr type A femurs without increasing fracture risk.
summary_en.method: Cadaveric paired femurs (n=6 pairs) were implanted with established (Corail) and modified (Emphasys) stems; broaching/implantation forces, contact areas, and relative motions under cyclic ISO 7206-4 loading (up to 1600 N) were measured using digital image correlation.
summary_en.result: The modified stem achieved 40% higher implantation forces, 23% larger bone-implant contact area, and four times lower subsidence, indicating improved primary stability.
summary_en.validation: In-vitro cadaveric experiment with cyclic mechanical loading per ISO 7206-4 standard, measuring micromotion via DIC.

relevance_to_user: 直接研究短柄髋关节假体对齐对初始固定和应力传递的影响，与本方向高度相关。
why_not_core: Does not include experimental validation or patient-specific bone quality variation.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究短柄假体对齐对初始固定和应力传递的影响，为手术提供指导。
summary_zh.method: 基于两例髋关节骨关节炎临床病例，使用非线性有限元方法改变CCD角和屈曲角。
summary_zh.result: 内翻位时假体内侧沉降增加，外翻位时股骨近端应力较高但差异较小。
summary_zh.validation: 仅通过数值模拟验证，无实验对照。

summary_en.motivation: To provide guidelines for short stem installation by numerically investigating the effect of alignment on initial fixation and stress transfer.
summary_en.method: Nonlinear finite element models with varied CCD and flexion angles were created based on two clinical hip osteoarthritis cases.
summary_en.result: Varus alignment increased medial stem settlement and distal femur stress, while valgus alignment increased proximal stress with slight differences.
summary_en.validation: Numerical simulation without experimental validation.

why_not_core: No fatigue testing and no explicit stress shielding analysis; LPBF fabrication is implied but not explicitly confirmed.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发仿生多孔骨盆假体以改善骨整合和力学匹配
summary_zh.method: 基于Voronoi图算法设计个体化多孔结构，增材制造Ti-6Al-4V假体
summary_zh.result: 压缩模量1.68 GPa、强度174 MPa，临床随访显示良好骨整合和功能评分
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM、压缩测试和6例患者临床随访验证

summary_en.motivation: To design a biomimetic porous hemipelvic prosthesis achieving favorable osseointegration and mechanical compatibility.
summary_en.method: Patient-specific porous structures were generated using Voronoi diagram algorithm and fabricated via additive manufacturing of Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.result: The porous structure exhibited a Young's modulus of 1.68 GPa and compressive strength of 174 MPa; clinical outcomes showed good osseointegration and a mean MSTS score of 23.2.
summary_en.validation: Validation included SEM imaging, compression testing of cubic samples, and clinical follow-up of six patients with X-ray and Tomosynthesis imaging.
